title: AI: Search Methods for Problem Solving
standfirst: The classical AI toolkit — state-space search, heuristics, adversarial games, and constraint satisfaction.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces the historical and philosophical foundations of artificial intelligence, along with general problem-solving frameworks and key search algorithms, including domain-independent, stochastic, local, and population-based methods. It also covers problem decomposition, rule-based approaches, game-playing algorithms, and the links between search, planning, constraints, and logical reasoning.
faculty: Prof. Deepak Khemani, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction; Machine learning evolution; Cognitive architecture; History and philosophy; Minds and machines; Problem solving.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: State space search; Search algorithms; Planning problems; Blind search; DFS, BFS, and iterative deepening.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Heuristic search; Hill climbing; Local search methods; Solution space search.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Hill climbing variants; Stochastic search; Genetic algorithms; TSP with GAs; Ant colony optimization.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: TSP optimization; Branch and bound; A* search; Admissibility of A*.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: A* variants; IDA* and RBFS; Monotone condition; Sequence alignment; Pruning in A*.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Game theory; Game types and trees; Evaluation functions; Minimax and Alpha-Beta; SSS* algorithm; Game demos.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Automated planning; Blocks world; State space planning; Goal stack planning; Partial order planning.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Robot planning; Means-ends analysis; Graphplan; Problem decomposition; AO* and goal trees.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Expert systems; Match, resolve, and execute; Rete algorithm and networks.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: CSPs; Constraint solving; Model-based diagnosis; Arc consistency; Constraint propagation.
